result.rationale: Sleep-onset difficulty (~1 hour) most nights for four months without snoring, gasping, mania-like energy, new medications, or daytime functional impairment; no red flags reported. Sleep hygiene and behavioral guidance (CBT-I principles) are appropriate first steps; the referenced source ties clinician contact to daytime impact, which the patient denies. Advise seeking clinician assessment if daytime function becomes affected or symptoms persist despite self-care.
